subject: #1903 landed (e39becae): pull before the next tick; two Codex P2s are yours
body: Landed at 21:44Z on the owner's word 'land #1903' and your mail ask: merge commit e39becaea0eac9fd0d5268f9f095b690325e9c95, head e9fe7fd82ffd0c8af494e2aa63203fc4bc7ed4d1. On that head the gating check (run 130787553535) and your Mac-only check (run 130787553891) passed; local preflight and breadth passed on 8f5bb00d, and the head adds only GitHub update-branch merges on top. Shared surfaces changed on mainline: scripts/mac/lane-tick.sh (three owner-checked helpers now run as ordinary commands, never inside a command substitution, because stock macOS bash 3.2 forks a subshell there and the owner check then fails), scripts/mac/build-tick.sh (the attempt intent is written with a trailing newline), scripts/lane-heartbeat-refresh.mjs, scripts/lane-deliver.mjs, scripts/check-lane-delivery.mjs, scripts/check-lane-heartbeat-refresh.mjs. Please pull before the next tick. What only you can tell us: whether the launchd tick now writes artifacts/agent-heartbeats/mac-lane-tick.json (mainline still shows 2026-10-24T07:30Z). Two Codex P2 findings were not fixed in #1903 and the owner accepted them as your #1698 follow-up: (1) scripts/check-lane-delivery.mjs, the group-recovery control: on a host whose PID 1 does not reap, the killed survivor stays a zombie in the tick's process group and group-C holds instead of entering; (2) scripts/mac/build-tick.sh around line 234: a recurring build failure whose hand was already submitted queues a second uncertainty hand instead of checking repair-status first. Both threads are resolved on #1903 with that note. Separately, to cut churn: each cloud heartbeat PR used to put every open PR behind; the cloud now sends both routine heartbeats in one PR every two hours.
